shortDescription: According to CNBC, a federal judge in Florida on Saturday dismissed with prejudice President Donald Trump’s amended defamation lawsuit against Rupert Murdoch and The Wall Street Journal. The suit challenged a Journal story alleging Trump sent Jeffrey Epstein a “bawdy” letter for his 50th birthday.
